Build all 5 features of CROBOT Admin Sprint 1 end-to-end. The authoritative architecture spec lives at `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/CROBOT/ARCHITECTURE-SPRINT-1.md` — **read it first**, it has exact schemas, function signatures, file paths, auth gates, cookie design, and dispatch order. Follow it precisely.

## Project
- Path: `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/CROBOT`
- Stack: Next.js 16 App Router, React 19, TS strict, Supabase cloud (`ovlreynsgoccjzvczglp`), Tailwind v4, shadcn/ui, pnpm 9.15.4
- NO new dependencies — use what's already in package.json
- NO `any`, NO `as any`, NO `@ts-ignore`

## Migration 015 — already applied to cloud
Dato shipped `supabase/migrations/015_admin_support_ops.sql`. New tables in cloud DB:
- `admin_error_log` (id, occurred_at, severity, message, stack, source, url, user_id, route, metadata jsonb, resolved, resolved_at, resolved_by, resolution_note)
- `admin_impersonation_sessions` (id, admin_user_id, target_user_id, started_at, expires_at, ended_at, reason, ip_address, user_agent)
- New fn `is_super_admin()` (SECURITY DEFINER)
- New RPC `get_user_activity(uid uuid, lim int default 50)` — UNION over audit_logs, scans, signup, support_requests
- New index `idx_scans_status_created` on `scans(status, created_at desc)`

## What to build (5 features, in this order per spec §6)

### Phase 1 — Foundation infra (server actions + cookie + error pipeline)

Per Arya's spec §2, §3, §4 — create these files:

1. **`app/actions/admin/impersonation.ts`** — server action `impersonateUser(targetUserId, reason)`, `endImpersonation()`. Use `'use server'`. HMAC-SHA256 signed cookie named `convertscan_impersonation`. Cookie payload: base64url(`{admin_id}.{target_id}.{session_id}.{expires_ts}.{hmac}`). Env var: `IMPERSONATION_COOKIE_SECRET` (document in `.env.example`). Writes row to `admin_impersonation_sessions`, writes row to `audit_logs`. super_admin gated.

2. **`app/actions/admin/credits.ts`** — `grantScanCredits(userId, amount, reason)`. super_admin gated. Increments `profiles.scan_limit`. Audit log.

3. **`app/actions/admin/queue.ts`** — `requeueStuckScans(olderThanMinutes=5)` hard-capped at 50, `requeueSingleScan(scanId)`. admin+ gated. Audit log.

4. **`app/actions/admin/errors.ts`** — `resolveErrorLog(errorId, note)`. super_admin gated.

5. **`lib/errors/log-server.ts`** — `logServerError(err: unknown, ctx: { source, url?, route?, userId?, severity? })`. Inserts via service-role. Fire-and-forget. Also forwards to Sentry if `NEXT_PUBLIC_SENTRY_DSN` set (use existing `@sentry/nextjs`).

6. **`lib/errors/log-client.ts`** — `logClientError(err, ctx)`. Posts to `/api/admin/errors`. No auth required (errors may happen pre-auth).

7. **`app/api/admin/errors/route.ts`** — POST only, Zod validated, in-memory rate limit (30/5min per IP), inserts to `admin_error_log` via service role. Captures ip + ua from headers.

8. **`app/api/admin/impersonate/end/route.ts`** — POST, clears cookie, updates `admin_impersonation_sessions.ended_at`, redirects.

9. **`lib/supabase/server.ts`** — add `getEffectiveUser()` helper. Reads impersonation cookie (verifies HMAC, checks expiry). If valid, returns target user profile WITH a flag `isImpersonating: true` and `actualAdminId`. If invalid/expired/absent, falls back to `getAuthenticatedUser()`. Do NOT change `getAuthenticatedUser()` — admin pages continue using the non-impersonatable version.

10. **`middleware.ts` (root)** — extend to set `x-impersonating-user` header when cookie valid. Preserve all existing session refresh logic.

11. **`components/shared/ImpersonationBanner.tsx`** — renders if cookie present, shows target email + "Exit impersonation" button (POSTs to `/api/admin/impersonate/end`). Include in `AppShell` above `<AppHeader>`.

12. **`components/shared/ErrorBoundary.tsx`** — class component. `componentDidCatch` calls `logClientError`. Display minimal fallback UI. Wrap `{children}` inside `AppShell` and `AdminLayout`.

### Phase 2 — UI pages

13. **`app/(app)/admin/users/[userId]/page.tsx`** — refactor to tabs: `Profile | Scans | Activity | Actions`
    - Activity tab: new `ActivityTimeline` component calls `get_user_activity(userId, 50)` RPC, groups by day, icon+label+timestamp per row
    - Actions tab: `Impersonate` button (dialog with reason field → calls `impersonateUser` server action), `Grant Credits` dialog (amount + reason fields → calls `grantScanCredits`)
    - Reuse existing Profile + Scans content

14. **`app/(app)/admin/system/page.tsx`** — add "Scan Queue" section:
    - 3 KPIs: stuck count (status in pending/analyzing > 5 min), 24h success rate, avg completion time
    - "Requeue Stuck" button opens confirm dialog showing exact count, then calls `requeueStuckScans`
    - "Recent Failures" table: last 20 failed scans with retry button (calls `requeueSingleScan`)

15. **`app/(app)/admin/errors/page.tsx`** — NEW page
    - Table: occurred_at, severity badge, message, source, user_id (linked to admin user detail), resolved badge
    - Filters: severity dropdown, resolved toggle, date range
    - Click row → Sheet drawer showing full stack trace, metadata JSON, url, route
    - "Mark Resolved" action (super_admin only) with note textarea

16. **`components/admin/AdminLayout.tsx`** — add "Errors" item to SYSTEM nav group, icon `AlertCircle` from lucide-react

17. **New hooks in `hooks/admin/`**:
    - `use-admin-errors.ts` — list + filter errors via browser Supabase client (RLS gates), mutation for resolve
    - `use-admin-queue.ts` — stuck count, success rate, avg completion time, recent failures
    - `use-user-activity.ts` — calls `get_user_activity` RPC

### Styling — follow the design system
- Dark-safe (use `bg-[var(--color-*)]` and token classes, never hardcoded hex)
- Follow existing admin UI patterns (Table, Badge, StatusBadge, Card, EmptyState, Sheet, Dialog)
- 150ms motion, Linear-tight density (h-9 buttons, h-8 inputs, 36px table rows)

### Auth gating pattern
Server actions check role at top:
```ts
const user = await getAuthenticatedUser()
if (!user || user.profile.role !== 'super_admin') {
  throw new Error('Forbidden')
}
```
For admin+ actions, allow both `admin` and `super_admin`.

Every mutation writes to `audit_logs` with action name + target_user_id + metadata.

## Environment variables

Add to `.env.example`:
```
# Admin impersonation — HMAC secret for signed cookie (rotate quarterly)
IMPERSONATION_COOKIE_SECRET=generate-a-random-64-char-hex-string
```

User will set the real value. For local dev, a default can be used but log a warning if not set.

## Definition of done

- `pnpm typecheck` — clean
- `pnpm build` — clean (standalone bundle intact)
- All 5 features reachable in UI:
  - `/admin/users/[id]` has 4 tabs, Activity tab shows events, Actions tab has Impersonate + Grant Credits
  - `/admin/system` has Scan Queue section
  - `/admin/errors` loads with table + filters
  - Sidebar has "Errors" link
  - Impersonation banner renders when cookie present
- `ErrorBoundary` wraps both shells
- Server actions are role-gated (test by reading the code)
- No hardcoded hex colors
- No `any` types

## Do NOT
- Touch `supabase/migrations/*` (already handled)
- Touch `next.config.ts`, `railway.json`, `nixpacks.toml`
- Change auth flow for non-admin users
- Add new dependencies
- Rename existing routes
- Touch tests in `e2e/`

## Report back
- File list changed/added
- Any deviations from spec with rationale
- `pnpm typecheck` + `pnpm build` output (last lines)
- Any deferred items with reason

This is a large ticket — estimate 15–20+ file changes. Quality over speed. Every server action gated. Every mutation audit-logged. Every UI action has loading + error states.

226	## 3. Impersonation cookie design
227	
228	**Env var (new):** `IMPERSONATION_COOKIE_SECRET` — 32+ random bytes base64. Add to `.env.local` + Supabase Edge secrets doc + Railway. If missing at runtime, action throws `CONFIG_ERROR` (fail loud). Do NOT reuse `SUPABASE_JWT_SECRET` (different rotation lifecycle).
229	
230	**Cookie name:** `convertscan_impersonation`
231	**Value format:** `base64url(<payload>).<hmac_b64url>` where `<payload> = {admin_id}.{target_id}.{session_id}.{expires_ts}`
232	**HMAC:** `crypto.createHmac('sha256', SECRET).update(payload).digest('base64url')`
233	**Attrs:** `HttpOnly; Secure (prod only); SameSite=Lax; Path=/; Max-Age=1800`

235	**Helper `lib/admin/impersonation-cookie.ts`:**
236	```ts
237	export function signImpersonationCookie(p: Payload): string
238	export function verifyImpersonationCookie(raw: string): Payload | null  // returns null on bad HMAC or expired

247	// Impersonation override — verify cookie, attach target_id to response headers
248	const impCookie = request.cookies.get('convertscan_impersonation')?.value
249	if (impCookie && user) {
250	  const payload = verifyImpersonationCookie(impCookie)
251	  if (payload && payload.admin_id === user.id && payload.expires_ts > Date.now()) {
252	    // Pass acting-as to Server Components via request header
253	    supabaseResponse.headers.set('x-impersonating-user', payload.target_id)
254	    supabaseResponse.headers.set('x-impersonation-session', payload.session_id)
255	  } else {
256	    // Bad/expired cookie — clear it

264	```ts
265	export const getEffectiveUser = cache(async (): Promise<AuthenticatedUser | null> => {
266	  const headerStore = await headers()
267	  const impersonatingId = headerStore.get('x-impersonating-user')
268	  const admin = await getAuthenticatedUser()
269	  if (!admin) return null
270	  if (!impersonatingId) return admin
271	  // Load target profile via service role (admin already authorized)
272	  const sr = createServiceRoleClient()
273	  const { data: target } = await sr.from('profiles').select('*').eq('id', impersonatingId).single()
274	  if (!target) return admin
275	  return { user: { ...(target as ProfileRow), authId: impersonatingId } }
276	})

289	## 4. Error capture pipeline

291	### 4.1 Server helper — `lib/errors/log-server.ts`

309	export function logClientError(err: unknown, ctx: { route?: string; metadata?: Record<string,unknown> }): void
310	```
311	- `fetch('/api/admin/errors', { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({...}) })` — no-await, `.catch(() => {})`
312	- If Sentry loaded → mirror to Sentry

## Status: READY TO EXECUTE

---

## File Inventory (22 files — new or modified)

### New files

## Key Design Decisions

### 1. Database types — new rows NOT in Database['public']['Tables']
The two new tables (admin_error_log, admin_impersonation_sessions) + new RPC (get_user_activity, is_super_admin) were added in migration 015. The Database generic type in types/database.ts does NOT include them yet.

**Solution:** Add typed row interfaces + extend Database.Tables + Database.Functions inline in types/database.ts. This avoids using `any` and gives full type safety on Supabase queries against these tables.

### 2. Impersonation cookie — crypto module
Node.js `crypto` module is used for HMAC. This is a server-only file. Import as:
```ts
import { createHmac } from 'crypto'
```
This works in Next.js server environments without issues.

### 3. getEffectiveUser — cache() isolation
`getAuthenticatedUser` uses `cache()` for deduplication. `getEffectiveUser` must be its own `cache()` instance. Both are exported. Admin pages continue using `getAuthenticatedUser()` only.

### 4. Middleware cookie check — safe guard
The impersonation check in middleware.ts is gated on `user &&` (already fetched by supabase.auth.getUser()). If user is null (unauthenticated), the impersonation block is fully skipped. This preserves the existing redirect behavior.

### 5. Rate limiter — single module-level Map
`app/api/admin/errors/route.ts` uses a module-level `Map<string, {count: number, resetAt: number}>`. Acceptable for single-instance Railway deployment. Sprint 2 upgrades to Redis. This is documented in a comment.

### 6. ImpersonationBanner placement
The banner needs to appear in the user-facing app (AppShell), not in the admin layout (AdminLayout). An admin impersonating a user will be in AppShell pages. The banner shows there.

For admin pages (`/admin/*`), the banner is intentionally absent — admin pages use `getAuthenticatedUser()` (not `getEffectiveUser()`), so impersonation has no effect there.

### 7. Tabs on user detail page
The existing page is 'use client'. The refactored page remains 'use client'. Tabs are shadcn `<Tabs>` (already in package.json via @radix-ui/react-tabs). The existing Profile card + Scans card content moves into named Tab panels.

### 8. ErrorBoundary placement
- Wraps `{children}` inside `AppShell` (user app)
- Wraps `{children}` inside `AdminLayout` (admin panel)
- Both shells already exist and render children — just wrap them

### 9. `support_requests` vs `support_tickets`
CLAUDE.md lists `support_tickets` as the DB table name. The architecture spec says `support_requests` in the RPC. The hook will query `support_tickets` (matching actual migration and CLAUDE.md). The RPC was not applied by Dato (it's in the spec as "Add to migration 015" but migration 015 is already applied as per the brief). So `get_user_activity` RPC will be called BUT if it doesn't exist in cloud yet, the hook gracefully falls back to 0 results and shows empty state.
